meaning_ledger.fact: nv-rms is the rack aggregator: one API fronting every device class

meaning_ledger.fact: OOB reach: one drop to every BMC in the rack (18 compute tray BMCs in a GB300 NVL72), the NVSwitch tray BMCs, the power shelf controllers

meaning_ledger.fact: 18 compute tray BMCs per GB300 NVL72
